content.text:
I fixed the stack overflow with a one-line change in `packages/babel-helpers/src/index.ts`. I rebuilt and ran both examples from the issue, and the output is now correct. The existing test suites for babel-helpers, babel-core, transform-classes and transform-object-super all pass. I didn't add a new test.

**Cause:** The `set` helper contains an inner function named `set` and exports a function named `_set`. If your code already uses the name `set`, Babel renames the inner function to `_set` by adding an underscore. That is the same name the exported helper ends up with, so the exported `_set` called itself instead of the inner function.

**Fix:** In `permuteHelperAST`, when Babel picks new names for a helper's internal functions, it now also avoids the name the helper itself will be given. In the issue's examples the inner function becomes `__set`, and `_set` now calls `__set(...)` as intended.

The fix is in the shared helper-injection code rather than in the `set` helper alone. So it also covers the case the issue raised about other helpers having the same kind of `xxx` / `_xxx` name pair.
